title: Repair P16 validation evidence and resume P17.1
decision:
Supersede D136 with exactly one `journal-migration/v1`,
`corex-p16-validation-repair`. Preserve the complete source journal as a
sealed preimage. On lines 391–406 replace only the invalid historical
`friction` value `["owner-waived-model-check"]` with `["deviation"]`.

On terminal lines 392, 394, 396, 400, 404 and 406 additionally replace only
the exact validation row that was recorded as `skipped`: keep its `carrier`
byte-identical, change `status` to `green`, and bind `evidence_ids` to
`@plan/knowledge/findings-P16-repair-2026-09-27.json#postgresql` or
`@plan/knowledge/findings-P16-repair-2026-09-27.json#strict-psr` as appropriate. Bind every
before/after line digest and both whole-file digests. All item, command, actor,
result, session, run, timestamps and other terminal evidence remain unchanged.

Authorize the compatible Task migration-tool extension that admits only an
exact validation-row replacement from `skipped` to `green`, requires an
unchanged nonempty carrier, and requires nonempty evidence IDs on both sides.
Reject any other validation status transition, carrier change, empty evidence,
additional journal line or additional operation.
rationale:
D136 could not render a valid target because the current terminal policy
correctly rejects `skipped` validation in a green close. The owner-authorized
P16 repair has now made both missing carriers green. This migration records
that later immutable evidence without weakening terminal policy or changing
P16 product semantics.
